summary: Review current delegations now focuses on access PIM Manager does not manage, so clean-up is easier.

fixes.title: Review shows what still needs cleaning up
fixes.text: Assignments PIM Manager manages are hidden by default on Review current delegations. Tick show managed by PIM Manager to see them, marked MANAGED.

fixes.title: Deleted admin accounts no longer look active
fixes.text: Deleted accounts are hidden under Show removed and deleted and show no actions. Entra keeps them restorable for 30 days.

fixes.title: Setup steps as single downloads
fixes.text: Setup steps can now be downloaded as single files from Invardia, starting with the step that gives Invardia support its access.
